articles.title: Willson Contreras says hand injury 'felt like a fracture' as Red Sox await further testing after negative X-rays
articles.description: Willson Contreras is hoping for the best after experiencing intense pain after being hit in the hand by a pitch in the eighth inning of Thursday’s win — and initial X-rays suggest he might have avoided a doomsday scenario.

articles.title: Red Sox reactions: Trevor Story hits heroic homer in win; Willson Contreras leaves in serious pain
articles.description: A sleepy evening turned into an eventful one for the Red Sox in Texas — in good ways and bad. Seconds after Willson Contreras left the game in intense pain after being hit in the hand, Trevor Story hit a game-winning three-run homer.

articles.title: Red Sox’ Johan Oviedo reaches 98.5 mph in his first rehab start for WooSox
articles.description: Red Sox pitcher Johan Oviedo topped out at 98.5 mph during his first rehab start on Thursday for Triple-A Worcester.

articles.title: Red Sox keeping rotation 'open-ended' as playoff berth nears, Wild Card matchup looms
articles.description: The Red Sox will start Sonny Gray in Thursday’s series finale against the Rangers and lefty Ranger Suarez on Friday night at Tropicana Field. After that, it’s anyone’s guess — and that’s somewhat of a product of the situation the club finds itself in.

articles.title: Sonny Gray on surviving Yankees nightmare: 'I felt like there's nothing I can't do now'
articles.description: Sonny Gray will likely face the Yankees in the first game of the playoffs, nearly eight years after his rocky tenure in New York ended. Without that experience, he said this week, he would have never been able to dominate for the Red Sox at age 36.

articles.title: Fenway Insider Live: Sean McAdam on struggling Red Sox offense, Kristian Campbell and more
articles.description: MassLive’s Fenway Insider Sean McAdam hosted a mailbag Thursday, Sept. 17 to highlight the latest news from the Boston Red Sox.

articles.description: The Red Sox 6-foot-7 pitching prospect added a sixth pitch during July.

articles.title: Red Sox loss includes Willson Contreras reminding himself to be smart, rookie’s ‘not horrible’ start
articles.description: For the first time since being acquired at the trade deadline, Red Sox reliever Erik Miller imploded Wednesday in a 7-3 loss to Texas.

articles.title: Red Sox reactions: Bullpen falters, bats muster three hits in second straight loss to Rangers
articles.description: Willson Contreras put the Red Sox up 2-0 in the first inning Wednesday. From there, it was virtually all Texas as the Rangers won for the second straight night.

articles.title: Could a 60-steal minor leaguer make his MLB debut for the Red Sox in the postseason?
articles.description: Only six players have ever made their major league debut in the postseason, and none of them have been with the Red Sox. That could change in the coming weeks with Braiden Ward in the mix to make Boston's postseason roster.

articles.title: Red Sox reliever Tyron Guerrero suffers minor setback, delaying return from IL by a few days
articles.description: The Red Sox expected to have hard-throwing reliever Tyron Guerrero back from the injured list Wednesday against the Rangers, but a minor setback has delayed his return to the bullpen.

articles.title: Which eight Red Sox prospects will play in Arizona Fall League?
articles.description: Infield prospect Mason White is the top Red Sox prospect headed to play in the Arizona Fall League.

articles.title: Red Sox playoff berth not ‘set in stone’ yet — but early clinch will benefit them
articles.description: With 11 games to go, the Red Sox are getting close to clinching a postseason berth. Here's how getting that done early will benefit them.

articles.title: Red Sox have lefty masher in Worcester batting .344 — and he's 'ready'
articles.description: Infielder Romy Gonzalez admits that he rushed his rehab assignment to return quicker to the Red Sox. "There's no doubt about it."
